title.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro：3D 创作与长程代码
title.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro: 3D creation and long-horizon code

notes.zh: 演示什么：官方页把 K3.1 Pro 的 1M 上下文、3D 创作与长程 coding 放在一起——给文字/草图/参考图生成 3D 模型，直接写并运行 Blender、CAD 脚本；还展示了一个 296 骨骼 / 402 肌肉的人体行走仿真器，模型自己定位并修正肩部力臂的 36 处错误。\n官方怎么说：这些案例由 K3.1 Pro 端到端完成，Kimi App 同步上线 3D Make，可在线预览和编辑 3D 模型；官方页写「完整权重将于 11 月 4 日前发布」，现已兑现（2026-11-25 复核）。\n边界：官方自述案例，不是受控基准；没有给完整 prompt、种子和工程文件；Terminal-Bench / Kimi Code Bench 分数是厂商口径，不能当作独立复现结论。
notes.en: What it shows: the official page combines K3.1 Pro’s 1M context, 3D creation and long-horizon coding — text/sketch/reference image to 3D, writing and running Blender/CAD scripts, plus a 296-bone / 402-muscle human walking simulator where the model locates and fixes 36 shoulder moment-arm errors.\nWhat the official page says: these cases were completed end-to-end by K3.1 Pro; Kimi App also shipped 3D Make with online preview and editing; the official page said full weights were due by 4 November; the promise was kept (rechecked 2026-11-25).\nBoundary: vendor case studies, not a controlled benchmark; full prompts, seeds and project files are not provided; Terminal-Bench / Kimi Code Bench scores are vendor figures, not independently reproduced conclusions.

title.zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash：15 秒视频与多轮编辑
title.en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15-second video and multi-turn editing

notes.zh: 演示什么：官方页展示原生 15 秒视频、更强的参考一致性、多轮对话式编辑、自然语音与更稳的运镜；可以先用 360p/720p 快速草拟，再对细节做一次 follow-up edit，最后升到 1080p/4K，而不是整段重生成。\n官方怎么说：15 秒、720p 下每美元成本比 1.1 低 30%，已在 Gemini API 与 Google Cloud 正式可用；输出带 SynthID 水印。\n边界：官方精选案例，不是同题横评；没有给完整 prompt、参考图与种子；运动、快速剧本变化和复杂物理仍是官方承认的待改进项。
notes.en: What it shows: the official page demonstrates native 15-second video, stronger reference adherence, multi-turn conversational editing, natural speech and steadier camera moves; you can draft at 360p/720p, fix a detail with a follow-up edit, then upscale to 1080p/4K instead of regenerating the whole clip.\nWhat the official page says: 15 seconds at 720p costs 30% less than 1.1, is generally available on the Gemini API and Google Cloud, and outputs carry a SynthID watermark.\nBoundary: curated vendor examples, not a same-prompt head-to-head; full prompts, references and seeds are not provided; fast sports action, rapid script changes and complex physics remain acknowledged gaps.

title.zh: Hy4 flash：150+ tok/s 的办公任务
title.en: Hy4 flash: 150+ tok/s for everyday work

notes.zh: 演示什么：官方页用 WorkBuddy 的日常任务展示 Hy4 flash——PPT 制作与编辑、文档编辑、表格修复、音视频处理、视觉理解；模型 224B 总参（含 64B Engram）、12B 激活、1M 上下文，解码超过 150 tokens/s。\n官方怎么说：Hy4 flash 在内部 WorkIndex 上略优于 770B/49B 的 Hy4 Preview，单任务成本约为 Hy4 Preview 的 1/13；11 月 30 日前 WorkBuddy 免费，腾讯云 TokenHub 五折。\n边界：WorkIndex 是腾讯内部基准，不是公开横评；85 人 / 259 任务的盲测是厂商自述；Hy4 flash 的开源是计划，不是已发布；没有给完整 prompt 与任务集。
notes.en: What it shows: the official page uses WorkBuddy tasks to demonstrate Hy4 flash — slide creation/editing, document editing, spreadsheet repair, audio/video processing and visual understanding; the model has 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram), 12B active, 1M context and over 150 decoded tokens/s.\nWhat the official page says: on the internal WorkIndex, Hy4 flash slightly outperforms the 770B/49B Hy4 Preview at about 1/13 the per-task cost; WorkBuddy is free until 30 November and TokenHub is 50% off.\nBoundary: WorkIndex is Tencent’s internal benchmark, not a public head-to-head; the 85-user / 259-task blind test is vendor-reported; open-sourcing Hy4 flash is a plan, not a shipped release; full prompts and task sets are not provided.
